                                           Walk-in-Interview
      Applicants having latest UGC and State Govt. norms are invited to attend an interview on
25.09.2026 at 11.00 AM for the position of One (1) Assistant Professor (Contractual) in the
Department of Biotechnology (Self-Financing Department) of Pandu College, Pandu, Guwahati
781012.

       Applicants are requested to bring with them all the testimonials from HSLC onwards in
original with the application for verification.
       The assignment will be completely contractual with one-month gap in every year and to
be funded by the college itself. The assigned teacher will not have any claim for permanent post
in future by dint of this assignment.
        The upper age limit is 43 years as on 01.01.2026 (age relaxation may be considered based
on relevant experience)
Essential qualification:             M.Sc. Biotechnology fulfilling UGC and State Govt. Norms,Teaching/
                                     research experience in Plant Biotechnology/Plant Tissue Culture is
                                     desirable.

Monthly Remuneration:                Rs.21600/- (from college fund)
No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing the interview.
